items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: I knew Frank Sinatra, and not really, who knew Frankie? Not really, but I’ll tell you something, I hadn’t seen him but once in fifty years

ctx.x: I will be 83 years old and one of the things, I’m just a little sad right now, because I knew Frank Sinatra, and not really, who knew Frankie? Not really, but I’ll tell you something, I hadn’t seen him but once in fifty years, can you imagine that? And I’ve been everywhere. Every place he went, we went, because you know the Erskine Hawkins band, we went everywhere.
Can I ask you about when you moved to New York, did you come with your mother?
